warning svelte_component_deprecated 12:1-12:53 `<svelte:component>` is deprecated in runes mode — components are dynamic by default

warning non_reactive_update 3:6-3:13 `Dynamic` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
